description: book a scheduled maintenance visit for my car
utterances: car is due its 20k check, got any slots next week
The service reminder on my dash came on this morning and the mileage matches what the manual says, so I'd like to bring it in sometime this month.

description: move an existing service appointment to another day
utterances: can i push my thursday booking to the following week
Something came up at work and I can't drop the car off on the morning we agreed, could you find me a slot later in the month instead?

description: cancel an upcoming service appointment
utterances: need to scrap my booking for saturday, sorry
I've decided to sell the car before the visit we scheduled, so please take me off the list for that morning and let me know if there's any fee.

description: switch between winter and summer tyres
utterances: time to put the winter set on, when can you fit me in
My summer tyres are stored with you and the temperatures are dropping, so I'd like to get the winter set fitted and balanced before the first frost.

description: book the annual roadworthiness test
utterances: my mot expires at the end of the month, can you do it
The certificate on my car runs out in three weeks and I'd rather have the dealer handle the test than a random garage, what days do you have open?

description: get the air conditioning regassed
utterances: ac is blowing warm, can you recharge it
The cooling in my car has gotten weaker every summer and now it barely does anything, I'd like someone to check the system for leaks and refill it.

description: check whether my car has an open recall
utterances: is there any recall out on my model right now
I saw something online about airbag problems on cars like mine from around the same year, can you look up my registration and tell me if it's affected?

description: schedule the fix for a recall notice i received
utterances: got the recall letter, when can you do the fix
The manufacturer sent me a notice saying the fuel pump on my car needs replacing free of charge, so I want to get that work booked in soon.

description: order a replacement part for my car
utterances: need a new wing mirror for my hatchback, can you get one
The plastic cover on my rear bumper cracked in a parking lot and I'd like to buy a genuine one from you rather than a knockoff online.

description: ask whether a specific part is in stock
utterances: do you have brake pads for my model on the shelf
Before I drive across town I want to know if you currently carry the cabin air filter for my car or if it would have to be ordered in.

description: ask when a part i ordered will arrive
utterances: any update on that headlight i ordered last week
You told me the replacement window regulator would be here in five working days and it's now been over two weeks, could you check where it is?

description: return a part that does not fit my car
utterances: the filter you sold me is the wrong size, can i bring it back
I picked up a set of wiper blades from your parts counter yesterday but they're for the older body style and don't clip on, I'd like to swap them.

description: claim a repair under the manufacturer warranty
utterances: gearbox is failing and the car is barely two years old, this should be on you
The infotainment screen went black last week and the car is still inside the factory coverage period, so I want to open a claim and have it replaced free.

description: ask whether a fault is covered by warranty
utterances: would a leaking water pump be covered or do i pay
My rear camera keeps cutting out, and before booking anything I want to know whether an electrical fault like this is included in the coverage that came with it.

description: find out when my warranty runs out
utterances: how long have i got left on the factory cover
I bought the car new about three years ago and can't find the paperwork, could you tell me the exact date the manufacturer coverage ends?

description: extend the warranty beyond the factory period
utterances: can i add extra years of cover before it lapses
The original protection on my car expires soon and I plan to keep it for years, so I'd like to hear what longer plans you offer and the pricing.

description: ask when my car will be ready to collect
utterances: any idea what time i can grab the car today
You've had my car since Monday for the clutch job and I haven't heard anything, could you give me a realistic estimate of when it'll be finished?

description: get a courtesy car while mine is being repaired
utterances: will you have a spare vehicle for me during the repair
The work is going to take most of the week and I still need to get to my job, is there a replacement vehicle I could use meanwhile?

description: have the shop pick up and return my car
utterances: can someone come fetch the car from my house for the service
I work long shifts and can't get to the dealership during opening hours, do you offer a driver who takes the car in and brings it back afterwards?

description: collect my car outside of opening hours
utterances: can i get the keys after you close tonight
My car will be finished this afternoon but I can't leave the office before seven, is there a key safe or some way to pick it up late?

description: get a price estimate before a repair
utterances: roughly what would a new clutch set me back
The exhaust is hanging low and rattling, before I commit to anything I'd like a written breakdown of parts and labour so I can compare with another garage.

description: question charges on my repair bill
utterances: why is the bill double what you said on the phone
The invoice lists three hours of labour for a job you told me would take one, and there's a diagnostic fee nobody mentioned, I'd like this explained.

description: authorize extra work found during the service
utterances: yeah go ahead and do the brake discs too
Your technician called to say the rear shocks are leaking and should be replaced while the car is on the lift, that's fine with me, please proceed with it.

description: decline extra work the shop recommended
utterances: skip the fluid flush, just do what i booked
The advisor suggested replacing the cabin filter and doing a wheel alignment on top of the service, but money is tight so I only want the original job done.

description: report a warning light on the dashboard
utterances: orange engine symbol came on this morning, is it safe to drive
A little yellow icon that looks like an engine outline lit up on my instrument cluster during my commute and hasn't gone off, what should I do about it?

description: report an unusual noise while driving
utterances: there's a grinding sound whenever i brake, can you look
For the last few days I've been hearing a rhythmic knocking from the front left whenever I go over bumps, and it's getting louder, I'd like it checked.

description: complain the same fault came back after a repair
utterances: you fixed the leak last month and it's leaking again
I paid you to sort out the stalling issue three weeks ago and the car is doing the same thing again, I expect this put right without another bill.

description: complain that my car was damaged during the service
utterances: there's a new scratch on the door since you had it
When I collected the car there was a dent in the rear quarter panel that wasn't there when I dropped it off, who do I speak to about this?

description: complain that the repair is taking far longer than promised
utterances: it's been three weeks for a two day job, what's going on
I was told the bodywork would be done by last Friday and every time I call I get a different excuse, I want a firm completion date now.

description: get a copy of my service records
utterances: can you print out everything you've done to my car
I'm putting the car up for sale and the buyer wants proof of every visit, could you send me a stamped summary of all the work carried out here?

description: get a dent or scratch repaired
utterances: someone keyed my door, can you sort the paint
A trolley rolled into my rear bumper in a car park and left a deep scuff, I'd like it filled and resprayed to match the original colour.

description: get a replacement key programmed for my car
utterances: lost my only key fob, what do i do now
One of my two remote keys has stopped working and the battery isn't the problem, I need a new one cut and coded to the car.
